prod_defects.description: SizeOfStruct formula yields 89 but SymFromAddr only accepts 88 on x64. The formula sizeof(_SYMBOL_INFO) - sizeof(c_char*1024) + sizeof(c_char) = 1112 - 1024 + 1 = 89. The correct value is offsetof(Name) + sizeof(Name[1]) rounded to 8-byte struct alignment = 84 + 1 = 85 rounded to 88. SymFromAddr rejects 89 with ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER (87). Additionally, the name is read from sym_header_size=89 instead of Name.offset=84, reading 5 bytes past the actual name start.
prod_defects.evidence: Empirical test: SymFromAddr with SizeOfStruct in {84,85,89} returns False (err=87); SizeOfStruct=88 returns True with NameLen=17 and name='GetCurrentProcess' at offset 84.
prod_defects.fix: In _resolve_symbol, replace the formula with: sym_header_size = SYMBOL_INFO.Name.offset + ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_char) and round up to 8: sym_header_size = ((sym_header_size + 7) // 8) * 8 = 88. Also change name-reading offset from sym_header_size to SYMBOL_INFO.Name.offset.
